body: Making these allow echo lets them switch too fast. When two scenes have inspectors open, it can crash.

In the future, should `CONTEXT_SLOT_SCRIPT_EDITOR_CODE` be allowed for text files and shaders as well?

Due to the shader editor rebase, the related `CONTEXT_SLOT_SCRIPT_EDITOR` now works in the shader editor list.
I don't think that was intentional...

I think it's fine. #118569 handles this in a generic way by providing file path of the edited resource, so I guess we have to rename the enum entry to be more accurate. The docs should clarify it at least.
